g.text: Threading: dividing a program or process into multiple smaller tasks

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: each of the smaller task is called a thread.

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
